deliverables: WP1 – Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
Open-source payments infrastructure for onchain settlement through smart contracts
Connections to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces
Smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, and settlement logic
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund “Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex,” submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ada, consisting of 3,846,153 ada for WP1 and 115,385 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.

Wirex proposes to deliver full-stack, open-source payments infrastructure enabling onchain settlement through smart contracts and connecting Cardano to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces.
A core proposed outcome is Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances, allowing users to spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants.
Wirex is described as having 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, more than $20 billion in transaction volume, and experience as a Visa Principal Member.
The proposal states that all components will be released as a public good for wallet providers, fintechs, stablecoin issuers, and developers to reuse.
The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested withdrawal is asserted not to breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.

Intersect states that funds will be managed through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with TRSC and PSSC addresses, role-based approvals, external oversight entities, and milestone-based disbursement controls.
The Oversight Committee is stated to consist of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl, with a role to verify key administrative actions using on-chain logic.
The proposal states that Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document requests 3,961,538 ada for a Wirex real-world payments initiative and describes broad payments, card, wallet, smart-contract, and oversight arrangements, but many adoption, execution, feasibility, and impact claims are asserted rather than substantiated in the anchor text.
